description: Na₂Cr₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.77 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.76 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Cr atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Cr atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Cr atoms.
